faqs.question: What is the time limit for filing a civil suit under CPC?
faqs.answer: Under the Limitation Act, 1963, the general time limit for filing a civil suit is 3 years from the date when the cause of action arises.

faqs.question: What are the essential elements of a plaint under CPC?
faqs.answer: A plaint must contain: 1) Name of court, 2) Name and description of parties, 3) Facts constituting cause of action, 4) Relief claimed, 5) Valuation of suit, 6) Verification clause.
